description: This source file defines the LabelFile class in the org.apache.ofbiz.webtools.labelmanager package. It encapsulates information about a label file, including its file object and component name, and provides accessor methods.

classes.name: LabelFile
classes.description: A class that represents a label file, providing methods to access its associated file and component name.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the File object representing the label file.

methods.name: getFileName
methods.description: Returns the name of the label file.

methods.name: getFilePath
methods.description: Returns the file system path of the label file.

methods.name: getComponentName
methods.description: Returns the component name associated with this label file.
